comment: TASK-14: reconciliation map from pinned upstream test files to port artifacts. statuses: adopted (name-set equality modulo renames/missing), partial (adopted semantics plus a recorded missing set), deferred (owner required, no port yet), excluded (reason required). missing entries carry per-case reasons. skipped entries (TASK-14.2) are the lawful dispositions for port cases that are @Disabled/@Ignore without a mirrored upstream ignore: each carries a reason plus exactly one of exclusion (a DEC reference naming the declared non-ported feature) or owner (the TASK that owes the case; release validation rejects while any owner skip is open). fixture entries must carry no test methods on either side (validated). Sources: docs/task9-case-accounting.md, docs/task13-case-accounting.md.
